package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    String color,
    String maybeColor,
    String nested,
    String oneOfConst,
    String mixedConst,
    String objConst
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (String) map.get("color"),
            (String) map.get("maybeColor"),
            (String) map.get("nested"),
            (String) map.get("oneOfConst"),
            (String) map.get("mixedConst"),
            (String) map.get("objConst")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("color", color);
        map.put("maybeColor", maybeColor);
        map.put("nested", nested);
        map.put("oneOfConst", oneOfConst);
        map.put("mixedConst", mixedConst);
        map.put("objConst", objConst);
        return map;
    }
}
